title: Patch: a counted game's result reloads the card proficiency the Collection shows, so a level the game earned and its stamp appear without a reload
notes: When a counted game's result pays the account (match.economy set on the match screen), the client loads the account's card proficiency again: cards/proficiencySync.ts's reloadOwnProficiency(), called from routes/match.tsx's paid effect beside announceWallet(), queues a GET /api/proficiency behind any stamp pick in flight (R4977000, amending R3013001). A level the game earned and the stamp it unlocks show in the Collection and can be worn without a page reload. No card looks or plays differently; claims --visual because the change touches apps/web/src/cards/ (R2529000), a micro of no family.

player.title: Card levels show as soon as a game ends
fixes: A card level an online game earned now shows in the Collection as soon as the game ends, and the stamp it unlocks can be worn at once, without reloading the page.
